prerequisites: Basic knowledge on mechanics, geometry and calculus

learning_outcomes.text: Explain the principles that underlie the operation of machinery and describe the most important mechanisms used in industrial applications.
Achieve basic technical training in mechanics of machines, useful for interfacing with specialists from other engineering fields.
Acquire knowledge to develop projects using appropriate methodologies, techniques and methods.
Solve mechanical engineering problems using the typical methods of Mechanics of Machines.
Develop models to approach the main problems of machine mechanics, with particular reference to the kinematic, static and dynamic analysis of machines and simple mechanical systems.

Correctly formulate a problem, identify appropriate assumptions and models, select suitable analysis tools, quantitatively develop the solution and critically assess the physical and engineering consistency of the obtained results.
Recognize the most important types of mechanical components and understand the fundamental aspects of their operation.
Develop an aptitude for logical reasoning firmly based on the scientific method, mainly due to the methodological rigor of the subject, as well as to train their ability to concentrate.

Critically address problems that cannot be immediately reduced to a predefined procedure, by verifying the consistency and reliability of the available data, formulating assumptions, selecting appropriate analysis tools and verifying the consistency of the obtained results.

syllabus_topics: Joints, degrees of freedom, contact mechanics
teaching_methods: Moodle platform resources (handouts, exercises, multimedia, videos)
assessment_rules: To pass, students must achieve at least 16 points out of 30 in the written test and a sufficient assessment in the oral examination, with an overall grade of at least 18 points out of 30. The final grade is obtained by combining the written test (40%) and oral exam (60%) assessments. Foreign-language students may take the exam in English upon request. The grading uses a thirty-point scale, with possible honours.
bibliography: "Meccanica Applicata alle Macchine", M. Fanghella P., Pellicano F., 3a edizione, CittàStudiEdizioni, 2022, ISBN:9788825174397

Teaching and multimedia materials available on the University Moodle platform, including handouts, videos, interactive resources and additional materials selected by the instructors. English-language resources will be made available to students who request them.
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica (Mechanical Engineering), classe L-9 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria industriale
